scheme_name: Coir Vikas Yojana-Skill Upgradation and Mahila Coir Yojana
other_conditions: Applicants must be Self Help Groups (SHGs), NGOs registered in the Darpan Portal of NITI Aayog, or Government Organizations
Applicants should have adequate infrastructural facilities such as work sheds, power connections, equipment, and raw materials
benefits_summary: Provides skill development training and financial assistance for coir workers and women artisans, including monthly stipends and subsidies for equipment
